definitions.explanation: A house built in European or American style, typically one put up between the Meiji era and the early Showa era. The word carries a strong period flavor: a modern Western-style home is a {洋風|ようふう}の{家|いえ}, not a {洋館|ようかん}.

examples.english: There is an old Western-style house on the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治時代|めいじじだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋館|ようかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: A Western-style house from the Meiji era is still in use today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山手|やまて}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当時|とうじ}→当時：01615_touji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋館|ようかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧{軒|げん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦されていて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Several period Western-style houses are preserved in the Yamate district of Yokohama, and you can tour the interiors.

notes:
⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) + ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (building). Contrast {和館|わかん}, the Japanese-style wing that often stood beside it on the same estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{洋館|ようかん}: an old Western-style house
- ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋館|ようかん}: a Meiji-era Western-style house
- {洋館|ようかん}{風|ふう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧: a cafe done up like a period Western house

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋風|ようふう}→洋風：13282_youfuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a Western-style home — the neutral term for any modern house in Western style
- ⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧: a mansion, an estate — large and imposing, but not necessarily Western

CULTURAL NOTE:
Preserved {洋館|ようかん} in Yokohama, Kobe, and Nagasaki are tourist attractions, and the word is a stock ingredient of mystery and ghost stories, where the isolated old {洋館|ようかん} is the standard setting.
